# deecrochet._

> Handmade crochet keychains, bag charms, bookmarks, pouches, figurines, bandanas, and bouquets stitched by hand in Udupi.

## Pages
- [Home](https://deecrochet.vercel.app/): Brand overview, featured handmade crochet collection, custom order steps, maker story, and Instagram contact.
- [All Products](https://deecrochet.vercel.app/collection): Complete catalog of handmade crochet items filterable by category (Keychains, Bouquets, Bags & pouches, Bag charms, Bookmarks, Figurines, Bandanas).

## Ordering
- [Instagram DM](https://ig.me/m/deecrochet._): Send a message on Instagram to order any piece or request custom colours, sizes, names, or designs.
- [Instagram Profile](https://www.instagram.com/deecrochet._): Follow @deecrochet._ for new pieces and behind-the-scenes updates.
